en:
## New Features

- File rollback now works on Windows servers, with a clear notice when the data volume (such as FAT/exFAT or some network drives) cannot support verified rollback
- Subagents that follow their parent now show which model they actually run, and warn when the allowed model pool forced a fallback
- A pinned subagent can switch back to following its parent from the model menu
- Global permission request dialog for plugins, with a "deny permanently" option

## Bug Fixes

- Stopping a subagent you have taken over now stops only its current turn instead of ending the takeover and returning early to the parent
- Subagents with no reasoning-effort override now follow the parent's live setting instead of a copy frozen at creation
- When the parent's model is not in the allowed pool, subagents fall back to the pool's first entry rather than the global default model
- A read-only directory grant on a parent folder no longer downgrades access to the narrator's own workspace
- Bash on Windows keeps working on volumes that cannot provide file identities
- Remote executor cancellation no longer drops the whole connection mid-frame; exec output limits follow the executor's configured maximum
- Remote Bash results now indicate when output was truncated
- Native browser JavaScript dialogs are dismissed automatically so browser sessions no longer hang
- Plugin permission events are shown to administrators only, and malformed deny requests are rejected instead of silently treated as a normal deny

## Improvements

- Short device RPC concurrency defaults to 64, and PTY sessions no longer count against it
- Execution-policy path checks run concurrently and can be cancelled
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 文件回退支持 Windows 服务端；若数据盘无法支撑可验证的回退（如 FAT/exFAT 或部分网络盘），会给出明确提示
- 跟随主代理的子代理会显示实际运行的模型，被模型池限制而回退时会给出提示
- 已固定模型的子代理可在模型菜单中重新切回“跟随主代理”
- 新增插件全局权限请求弹窗，支持“永久拒绝”

## 修复

- 停止已接管的子代理时只停止当前一轮，不再结束接管、提前把结果交回主代理
- 未单独设置推理强度的子代理会实时跟随主代理的设置，不再沿用创建时的快照
- 主代理的模型不在允许的模型池中时，子代理改用池中第一项，而不是全局默认模型
- 对上级目录的只读授权不再降低叙述者自身工作区的权限
- 在无法提供文件标识的磁盘上，Windows 的 Bash 仍可正常使用
- 远程执行器取消请求时不再中途断开整条连接；执行输出上限跟随执行器配置
- 远程 Bash 的结果会标明输出是否被截断
- 自动关闭浏览器原生 JS 对话框，避免浏览器会话卡住
- 插件权限事件仅推送给管理员；格式错误的拒绝请求会被拒绝，不再被当作普通拒绝处理

## 改进

- 设备短 RPC 默认并发提高到 64，PTY 会话不再占用该配额
- 执行策略的路径检查改为并发执行，并支持取消
